description: Cedar is a Custom Equalizer Designed for Audible Reading. It gives NVDA its own equalizer for speech, with bass, mid and treble controls, a set of presets, optional separate settings for each synthesizer, and a full parametric equalizer behind an advanced settings option. Warning: this add-on was vibe coded with Claude Opus 5, Anthropic's AI model. Expect oddities, and please report anything that behaves strangely.
changelog: The download file is now named with its version, such as cedar-1.7.2.nvda-addon. Nothing about how Cedar sounds or works has changed since 1.7.1.
